notes: Real federal solicitation (US Government work, public domain), 2020. Complete Section M (6 PDF pages). Evaluation criteria, plus offeror obligations stated only in Section M.

requirements.quote: Any exceptions or deviations by the Offeror to the terms and conditions stated in this solicitation for inclusion in the resulting contract may make the offer unacceptable for award
requires that the Offeror provide enough information in its statement to allow a meaningful evaluation by the Government
the Offeror’s certification required by the contract’s Section K provision, Certificate Pertaining to Foreign Interests
A Performance Guarantee Agreement in accordance with the requirements of the Solicitation’s Section L provision L-6
The Government intends to award one contract to the responsible Offeror whose proposal is responsive to the solicitation and is determined to be the best value to the Government
the Technical and Management Criteria, when combined, are significantly more important than the Cost Criterion
The Government will evaluate the Offeror's recent, relevant past performance
The Government will evaluate the Offeror’s Sites Organization, Key Personnel resumes, and information provided by Key Personnel references
Failure to submit the required letters of commitment may result in the Key Person not being evaluated
Proposed Key Personnel who are under a service commitment for the performance of another NNSA M&O contract at the projected time of contract award
The Government will evaluate the Offeror’s proposed UPF Interface Management Approach
The Government will evaluate the effectiveness of the Offeror's approach in using small businesses
The total evaluated price will not be rated, but will be used in determining the best value to the Government
